rules: PRODUCTION_SPEC §12–§18; flat LIGHT backgrounds; whole real products (Apple Newsroom images ONLY); 1–3 words on screen; 2-D objects next to the part; watermark per state/brand.md; logo end card; audio LOCKED settings as last video. NEVER use iFixit photos, video or CT scans — draw our own simple 2-D diagrams instead.
palette_for_this_video: paper #FAF8F5 main; cool-grey #EEF0F4 for hero shots (silver aluminium); blush #FBE7E2 for damage/hinge/woofer beats; mint tint #E6F4EC for GOOD NEWS; marigold object fills; ember accent text

scenes.anchor: two hundred ninety-nine dollar smart display
scenes.object: price tag swings in from the right on a string, tied to the speaker base
2-D screwdriver icon approaches the screen edge, bounces off; small 'locked' padlock pops on the bezel

scenes.anchor: seven-inch screen and an A eighteen chip
scenes.object: right side: diagonal measure line across the screen labelled '7"', then a simple chip square labelled 'A18' pops below
thick marigold glue bead traced around the screen edge (stroke animates around the rectangle); small 'stretch' strands when a 2-D pry tool tugs the corner

scenes.anchor: than on any Apple product they've opened recently
scenes.object: horizontal bar meter 'adhesive strength' — HomeView bar fills past a dashed line marked 'recent Apple'. No numbers (none published).
simple connector plug + socket; wire pulls and tears out of the plastic housing (jagged break line)
flat rectangular speaker icon cracks down the middle; halves tilt apart

scenes.image: A one unit (silver, far left) cropped, side profile, centred 70%
scenes.object: ember dashed line traced from screen down THROUGH the pivot into the base; two small screw icons appear on the pivot with a lock badge

scenes.anchor: can't come apart without special tools
scenes.object: screen and base try to slide apart, stop, shake; red ✕ over a generic screwdriver, then a 'special tool' icon (odd-shaped bit) appears
woofer circle at bottom, board rectangle above; cable between them stretched taut, only a few px slack; plug strains to reach

scenes.image: C base close crop (bottom 45% of image, speaker base), centred
scenes.object: small USB-C port module slides out of the base outline and back in; green check
arrow walks backward on a simple timeline: iPad icon ▸ HomePod icon ▸ (moving forward = easier) then HomeView marker drops back

scenes.anchor: iPads and HomePods got easier to fix
scenes.object: generic wrench icons with green checks above the iPad and HomePod icons (simple line icons, our own)
big verdict stamp 'WRECK' (ember) slams on, slight shake

scenes.anchor: Would you buy a gadget you can't fix?
scenes.image: C front centred (loops to scene 1 image)
scenes.object: two buttons SPEC / WRECK; question mark pulses
